name: docs
description: KookieUI docs. Bare Next.js as the rendering substrate; every visible pixel is @kookie-ui/react. No docs framework and no third-party UI — a design system whose docs are built on someone else's system argues against itself (decided 2026-08-05, Kushagra; LOG). Icons are the exception the package itself names: §8 ships no icon dependency because icons are ReactNode slots the APP fills, so the app fills them with Hugeicons (2026-08-10).
